mahāvrataṭīkā). W. p. 28.

vyākhyā). Hall p. 84.
राम guru of Madhusūdana Sarasvatī. Hall p. 119.

of Viṣṇu, father of Nīlakaṇṭha, father of Nāganātha,
father of Nṛsiṃha, father of Nāganātha, father of Jñā-
narāja (Siddhāntasundara), father of Sūrya (Līlāvatī-
ṭīkā 1539). W. p. 231.
राम brother of Viśrāma, son of Rāyamukuṭa (Padacandrikā).

राम pupil of Vidyādhara:
 Somakarmapradīpikā or Somakarmapaddhati.

राम son of Ananta, grandson of Cintāmaṇi, younger
brother of Nīlakaṇṭha:
 Muhūrtacintāmaṇi and its C. Pramitākṣarā, com-
posed at Benares in 1601.

राम son of Balabhadra, grandson of Śrīnandana, wrote
a Praśasti in 1002. Epigr. Ind. p. 146.

राम son of Viśveśvara, of the Vatsa race:
 Putrasvīkāranirṇaya.

राम son of Viśvanātha. read by request of Anūpasiṃha.
He had previously written five works in the following
order:
 Anūpaviveka (śālagramaparīkṣaṇa).
 Saṃtānakalpalatikā.
 Anūpakutukārṇava.
 Amṛtamañjarī med.
 Cikitsāmālatīmālā.

राम or रामचन्द्र son of Kṛṣṇa, grandson of Rāma-
candra:
 Ramalaśāstra.

राम son of Nandarāma, grandson of Janārdana, wrote
in 1799 a C. to the Caurapañcāśikā. He follows
Rādhākṛṣṇa in explaining the poem as referring
to Kālikā.

 Arkaprakāśaṭīkā.
 Aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkā.
 Mādhavanidānaṭīkā.
 Rasamañjarīṭīkā.
 Rasendracintāmaṇiṭīkā.

रामनाथ or रामचन्द्र guru of Mukunda Muni (Advaita-
jñānasarvasva etc.). Hall p. 100. 111.

रामनाथ son of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa, father of Rāmagopāla
Śarman (Varṇabhairava).

रामनाथ author of Rāmanāthapaddhati. Mentioned by
Vedajñāna in Ātmārthapūjāpaddhati.

C. on the Sūryasahasranāman from the Bhavi-
ṣyottarapurāṇa.

 Manoramā Kātantragaṇadhātuvṛtti.
 Śabdasādhyaprayoga Kātantra.

 Ācāravāridhi.

 Vṛttasāra.

tattvacintāmaṇi).

p. 205.

Hall p. 188.

yaṇācārya, pupil of Śālikācārya:

mṛta.

राम दैवज्ञ son of Keśava, brother of Ananta and Gaṇeśa,
father of Narasiṃha (Grahakaumudī, Grahadīpikā).

राम भट्ट Quoted by Rāghava in Nyāyasāravicāra. Hall
p. 26.

राम भट्ट son of Narasiṃha, an Andhra, father of La-
kṣmīdhara and Janārdana:
 Sārasvataprakriyāṭīkā Vidvatprabodhinī. He men-
tions Rūpanārāyaṇa, prince of Tīrabhukti.

राम भट्ट son of Viśvanātha, grandson of Mudgala Bhaṭṭa
Hosiṅga, wrote by request of king Bhūpasiṃha:
 Dānaratnākara.

राम भट्ट son of Śrīnātha:
 Bhāgaviveka or Dhanabhāgaviveka.

राम भट्ट (Yāhvaropanāmaka), father of Tippū Bhaṭṭa
(Saṃgrahaṇadīpikā on Āśvalāyana's Śrautasūtra).

राम भट्ट father of Nīlakaṇṭha (Tarkasaṃgrahadīpikāpra-
kāśa).

राम भट्ट or रायभट्ट son of Nārāyaṇa, grandson of Rāma-
rudra, father of Lakṣmīdhara (Piṅgalārthapradīpa
1600).

राम तर्कालंकार father of Mathurānātha Tarkavāgīśa
(Tattvacintāmaṇiṭīkā).
[]
